title: docs(skills): data-hooks teaches the hook and job js-body compile refusal
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuEoKvgs2TW7hc47KRGVnwtY)_
Fixes #35714

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: updated here

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:装了数据技能的应用作者(多数是 AI)在写钩子脚本时会知道,脚本编译不过会在校验、构建和保存时被拒,并且知道怎么改;平台行为不变。
- 为什么做:属于「已发布技能文档跟上平台行为」这条线,平台前一步已经开始拒收编译不过的钩子和定时任务脚本,技能页还没写这条。
- 出错会怎样:如果技能页写错,作者会按错误说法写脚本并在校验时碰壁;只改文字,撤回这一个合并即可。
- 要你做什么:无。

## What changes

`skills/objectstack-data/references/data-hooks.md`, section "Sandbox restrictions", gains one bullet after "Rejected by `objectstack build`":

> - **Refused when it does not compile:** a `js` source is compiled, unrun, inside its `(async (ctx) => { … })` wrapper, where `ctx` is already declared. So `const ctx = ctx.input || {};` (or `let ctx`, one name declared twice, any syntax error) is `hook-body-does-not-compile`: an **error** from `os validate`, `os build`, `os lint` and a runtime hook save (`422 INVALID_METADATA`), naming the hook, the `SyntaxError` and its line. Fix: use `ctx` as it is, or rename the local (`const input = ctx.input || {};`). A job's `js` body runs in the same wrapper: `job-body-does-not-compile`, from the three commands. A regex pattern only the checking engine refuses is a warning.

It names both rule ids, one minimal refused body and its repair, which is the card's Done-when.

`skills/objectstack-data/evals/hooks-security-seeds-datasources.json` gains case 33 at the end of the array (no other case touched): the refused `const ctx = …` body under `os validate`, graded on naming `hook-body-does-not-compile` and repairing through `ctx.input.status`.

A patch changeset for `@objectstack/skills`.

**Job bodies.** No published skill teaches a job `js` body: `git grep -n -i -E "defineJob|jobs?\b"` over `skills/` at 598a34d04 finds `jobs` / `defineJob` only as a collection name (`objectstack-automation/SKILL.md:5`, `skills/README.md:51`, `objectstack-platform/SKILL.md:36`) and `job` as a service token; no file shows a job `body`. So the job sentence lives in this one bullet and no second file is edited.

**One deliberate difference from the card's wording.** The card says the "save door" refuses a hook or job body. Main refuses a job body at the three commands only: no door publishes a job (`packages/spec/src/kernel/metadata-plugin.zod.ts:1040`, `allowRuntimeCreate: false`; `packages/lint/src/authoring-rules.ts:2986`, `runtimeTypes: ['hook']`). The skill says exactly that.

The new bullet is +9 lines, +691 bytes. It is paid in the same file, by the standing rule 「A:先削重复,余额按实测提高」 (ruling record 6513306068): six restatements removed, 713 bytes, each with its other home in the file. No remainder is left, so the ceiling row is not touched.

## Tests

Text only; no behaviour a test pins changed, so no ablation. Every taught fact was read on main (598a34d04) and probed.

<details><summary>Facts and where main states them</summary>

- Rule ids: `packages/lint/src/validate-hook-body-compiles.ts:51` and `:54`.
- The wrapper, `(async (ctx) => { SOURCE })`: `packages/lint/src/action-body-wrapper.ts:52-54` (`hookBodyFunctionExpression`); the rule compiles inside it at `validate-hook-body-compiles.ts:98` (hooks) and `:120` (jobs); the runtime runs the body in the same expression at `packages/runtime/src/sandbox/quickjs-runner.ts:435`.
- `js` bodies only: `validate-hook-body-compiles.ts:73-76`.
- Doors: `packages/lint/src/authoring-rules.ts:2980-2987` (`tier: 'gating'`, `commands: ALL`, `surfaces: CLI_AND_RUNTIME`, `runtimeTypes: ['hook']`); pinned by `packages/lint/src/validate-hook-body-compiles.test.ts:137-146` (validate, build and lint refuse the hook and the job) and `:148-160` (the runtime publish door refuses a hook write and admits `const input = ctx.input || {}`).
- `422 INVALID_METADATA` at the runtime door: `packages/metadata-protocol/src/runtime-authoring-gate.ts:1683-1684`.
- Severity split (a regular-expression pattern the host engine refuses is a warning, all else an error): `validate-hook-body-compiles.ts:32-34`, test `:94-95`.
- What the author is shown (hook or job name, the `SyntaxError`, `line N`): `validate-hook-body-compiles.ts:105-113`, `validate-action-body-compiles.ts:190`.

</details>

<details><summary>Probe run on 598a34d04 (the rule called on one hook and one job per body)</summary>

`tsx` over `validateHookAndJobBodyCompiles`, after `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build`:

```text
const ctx = ctx.input || {};   -> hook-body-does-not-compile error + job-body-does-not-compile error
   "body does not compile in the wrapper the runtime runs it in, (async (ctx) => { … }) (SyntaxError: Identifier 'ctx' has already been declared, line 1), so every run of this hook fails"
   hint: "`ctx` is already the parameter of the wrapper: use it as it is (the hook's record is `ctx.input`), or give the local another name, e.g. `const input = ctx.input || {}`"
let ctx;                        -> both ids, error
let x = 1; let x = 2;           -> both ids, error (Identifier 'x' has already been declared, line 1)
if (ctx.input.a { }             -> both ids, error (Unexpected token, line 1)
const r = /(?<a>x)|(?<a>y)/;    -> both ids, warning
const input = ctx.input || {};  -> no finding
language: 'expression' body     -> no finding
```

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The teaching says "from the three commands" for a job and "a runtime hook save" for a hook; it does not say a job save is refused, because no such door exists on main.
- `os lint` is named because the rule runs under it (`commands: ALL`); the neighbouring bullet's older "Rejected by `objectstack build`" wording is left as it is, outside this card.

## Verification

Read first: the new bullet in `skills/objectstack-data/references/data-hooks.md` (line 340), then the six deletions in the same file's diff (each is a restatement, check its other home in the table above), then eval case 33.
